sentences.text: Archaeonectrus was a relatively small plesiosaur measuring between 3.4 and 3.67 meters in length.
The type species Archaeonectrus rostratus was originally named by Sir Richard Owen in 1865 and later moved to its own genus by N.I. Novozhilov in 1964.
Archaeonectrus is classified within the family Pliosauridae, though the Paleobiology Database lists its parent group as Rhomaleosauridae and also places it in that family.
Archaeonectrus lived during the Early Jurassic period in what is now southeastern England.
